title: Sir Charles Thompson's minister father and his runaway
summary: Dance and Clayton discuss Charles Thompson's father, a minister in Independence, and how Charles slipped out a window to join a band from Omaha.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: The church people were quick to recognise jazz, huh? Now there's just one thing about the church. Wasn't Sir Charles Thompson's father ......
What religion was he, I mean what......
I never did know. But he was
He was a minister in Parsons?
No he was a minister about twenty miles from Parsons. A Town called Independence.
But didn't they live in Parsons?
Sir Charles lived there but I don't know if his father did. I'll have to ask about.
Yes, because I remember it was Parsons that some guys sneaked in the window and Sir Charles sneaked out of the window and ran away with his band from Omaha, from Nebraska.
